item.title: Two venues in fray for T20 World Cup 2026 semi-final 1; ICC sends communication to stakeholders
item.description: The International Cricket Council (ICC) has made a big change in the T20 World Cup 2026 schedule, as per which, Sri Lanka could play the first semi-final in Colombo if they qualify and aren’t drawn against India. item.title: “Never carried baggage from past,” Shikhar Dhawan calls out fake quotes about his personal life after second marriage
item.description: Former India opener Shikhar Dhawan has slammed people for circulating false statements about his personal life after his second marriage. The southpaw recently tied the marriage knot with girlfriend Sophie Shine after separating from his former wife, Aesha Mukerji, in October 2023. While Dhawan has often spoken about how much he misses to be with his son Zoravar, he never said anything malicious about his ex-wife in the public domain.
